decisions.reason: The source specifies referral-popup rules, while the represented About-page state contains no directly conflicting referral commission amount and may remain selective about which prize mechanics it describes.
The landing-page state still says each referral pays a $10 commission, which directly conflicts with the new $25 accepted-referral and $18 missing-or-rejected-referral rules.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
For the ' Valid referral number' popup, please apply the following rules:
\- Only NFTs confirmed before checkout should be valid.

\- When the referral is accepted, display: 'Referral accepted! $25 credit + entry into the $2,000 reward drawing for your chosen referrer.'

\- When the referral is missing or rejected, display: 'Referral unavailable! $18 commission and a $900 draw entry will be assigned to a random NFT owner.'

value_updates.mechanics_tease_text: Only NFTs confirmed before checkout are valid referrals. An accepted referral gives the chosen referrer a $25 credit and entry into the $2,000 reward drawing; a missing or rejected referral assigns an $18 commission and a $900 draw entry to a random NFT owner.
value_updates.commission_copy_requirement: Distinguish the $25 credit for an accepted referral from the $18 commission assigned to a random NFT owner when a referral is missing or rejected.

decisions.reason: The popup rules do not change the email provider, delivery behavior, notification channel, or currently required email contents.
Referral eligibility and reward allocation do not alter the email-link authentication method or dashboard-access behavior.
An existing same-message MODIFY already captures the missing-or-rejected trigger, random NFT owner, one $900 draw entry, obsolete ticket-key removal, and expanded invalid-referral scope.
An existing same-message MODIFY already records the $18 amount, missing-or-rejected trigger, random NFT owner, and invalid-referral scope.
An existing same-message MODIFY already replaces the prior Small Block ticket rule with one $2,000 reward-drawing entry for the chosen referrer when a referral is accepted.
The referral-popup rules do not affect the landing-page cover's presence, placement, cropping, or size.
An existing same-message MODIFY already records the $25 accepted-referral credit and its allocation to the chosen referrer; the source does not negate the existing automatic payout properties.
The referral-popup decision does not change the deferred Transak provider, wallet provisioning, supported payment methods, or fiat-mint flow.
The source introduces reward-drawing entries but does not specify or change their randomness provider, execution method, or Chainlink VRF applicability.
Referral validation and reward allocation do not change SIWE, supported wallet-authentication users, or protected flows.
